context: Sakura interviews a shop owner about a comeback.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business interview; vocabulary (旧/売っ/売る/きっかけ/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 旧い商品が、また売れているそうですね。
lines.en: I hear old products are selling again.
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そや、旧式が人気を取り戻したんや。
lines.en: Yeah, the old style regained popularity.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人気の、きっかけは何ですか?
lines.en: What was the trigger for the popularity?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: テレビで紹介されたのが、きっかけや。
lines.en: Being featured on TV was the trigger.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 宣伝に、力をかけたんですか?
lines.en: Did you put effort into promotion?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 宣伝に時間をかけて、よう売ったわ。
lines.en: I spent time on promotion and sold a lot.
lines.style: enthusiastic Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一日で、たくさん売ったんですか?
lines.en: Did you sell a lot in a day?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 飛ぶように売れたで。きっかけに感謝や。
lines.en: They flew off the shelves. I'm grateful for the trigger.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
